mechanism: Both drugs are commonly used in postmenopausal women with breast cancer; zoledronic acid may enhance letrozole's effects on bone metabolism and both carry independent risks for osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures.
action: Monitor for signs of osteonecrosis of the jaw, atypical fractures, and hypocalcemia; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider dental evaluation before initiation and during therapy.
